description: Use when you have a public DNS hostname and optional record type and need the matching DNS records and lookup status.

host.description: Public DNS hostname. IP literals, single-label names and local/reserved suffixes are rejected.

type.description: DNS record type to look up. Defaults to A. One of A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS, CNAME, CAA, SOA.

name: creator_desk_lookup_dns
